title: Hippih 10" Silent Quartz Decorative Wall Clock
text: Hippih 10" Silent Quartz Decorative Wall Clock. Arrived quickly (I have prime) and in good condition, very well boxed. It runs silently and accurately.  And it comes WITH a battery.  All in all, I think this was a good buy.  I could not find a silent, sweep hand clock any where locally and this was actually less that the regular, noisy ticking clocks that were available here. It is just as described... white face, with black print and a black frame... It's about 7" across just eyeballing it... it's close to that... between 6-8"  Perfect for my use on the kitchen/living area wall.  I never hesitate to update my reviews with any new info.
